description: PM-7a: assigning an AI plan from the main menu actually reaches the AI. No fixture — the scenario starts on the real menu, writes the shipped test plan into user://ai_plans/, then sets the Force Dispositions and terrain variant that DERIVE hammer_anvil (take_and_hold vs purge_the_foe, variant 3) so the plan's zone matches the game. Both seats are set to AI on recon_stomps, and the picker is asserted to offer the plan unflagged (army and zone both match). Player 2 is given the plan; player 1 is set to None, making the two seats a controlled comparison. After pressing Start it asserts the choice landed in meta.game_config, that AIDecisionMaker holds the plan for seat 2 and nothing for seat 1 — which also proves the install happens AFTER AIPlayer.configure(), since configure clears plans — and finally that deployment produces plan-sourced decision records for seat 2 and exactly zero for seat 1.

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
var army = -1
for i in range(m.army_options.size()):
	if str(m.army_options[i].id) == "recon_stomps":
		army = i
m.player1_dropdown.selected = army
m.player1_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", army)
m.player2_dropdown.selected = army
m.player2_dropdown.emit_signal("item_selected", army)
m.player1_type_dropdown.selected = 1
m._on_player1_type_changed(1)
m.player2_type_dropdown.selected = 1
m._on_player2_type_changed(1)
return "p1=%s p2=%s" % [str(m.player1_plan_container.visible), str(m.player2_plan_container.visible)]
